DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Retinitis

The CD4 count of 36/mm³ indicates severe immunosuppression, which, combined with your history of AIDS and the classic presentation of painless vision loss and floaters, strongly points to CMV retinitis rather than Tuberculosis. The "normal" viral load does not rule out this opportunistic ocular infection in this clinical context.
